rationale_text: Case 10539_1000549: a 1.51 cc lesion in the gland (PZ/TZ boundary) is moderately hypointense on T2W (z=-0.77 relative to same-zone background tissue) with round to oval, more circumscribed (sphericity=0.69) margins. A substantial portion of the lesion falls outside the automated whole-gland segmentation, suggestive of extraprostatic extension (note: the gland mask is AI-derived and not verified at the capsule boundary, so this may partly reflect gland-segmentation imprecision rather than confirmed extension). These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 4.
